selection_basis: 18 clips, 6 per AGE. 48 uniform time anchors per clip plus raw-overview-selected inversion/contact windows at stride 3; preserve all 72 previous sample indices. No current detector/tracker outputs used to select added frames. Exactly 80 per clip.
annotation_policy: Visible extent of target gymnast in original-pixel xyxy. Do not reconstruct hidden limbs or merge assistants. Uncertain extent/identity must be explicit ambiguous/occluded, never filled by interpolation. AI references accepted for study by user; provenance and human_reviewed=false retained.

case_replacement.reason: No gymnast exercising at any of the 12 raw overview anchors in removed clip; replacement shows an exercise. This is a selection observation, not exhaustive absence annotation.

limitations: Athlete identities unprovided; clothing cannot establish distinct identities
Apparent source-time overlap pair AGE1 000840/000905 kept together in development; different layouts prevent asserting duplicate frames from filenames alone
Reserved results must be assessed separately; after inspecting them the set is no longer an untouched reserve
